ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my setup, but this older speaker adds little beyond my existing voice remote.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so this would be redundant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for an older tablet; my recent purchases focus on television and cameras.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB UHS-I/Class 10 Micro SDHC Memory Card With Adapter - SDSDQUAN-032G-G4A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Extra camera storage could be useful, but I would need to confirm compatibility and a storage need first.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for memory cards, and compatibility with my recording equipment is unconfirmed.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 4 Port USB 2.0 Data Hub with Individual LED lit Power Switches [Charging NOT Supported] for Mac & PC (HB-UMLS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no clear need for more USB data ports, and this does not support charging.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent interests are home viewing and security equipment, with no current need for wired earbuds.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this as a compact Alexa display alongside my Fire TV setup, with camera viewing appealing if compatibility checks out.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Hands-free Alexa control appeals to me, but I would choose the Echo Show's screen this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics External Hard Drive Portable Carrying Case; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My history gives me no immediate reason to buy a carrying case for a portable hard drive.
